# Paper C: Cascade Reader Brief

## c1_scope
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_cascade; SECTION_KEY=c1_scope]
Paper Cascade Brief USES CascadeReader. CascadeReader TARGETS Cross Paper Evidence by reading several small research notes before composing a single answer.

## c2_dataset
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_cascade; SECTION_KEY=c2_dataset]
CascadeReader is EVALUATED_ON CitationWeave. CitationWeave is a Dataset where relation facts are intentionally split across paper cards.

## c3_metric
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_cascade; SECTION_KEY=c3_metric]
CascadeReader REPORTS MRR@10. MRR@10 is a Metric that rewards placing the first relevant source near the top of retrieval results.

## c4_concept
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_cascade; SECTION_KEY=c4_concept]
CascadeReader USES Relation Path. Relation Path is a Concept that records source entity, relation type, target entity, and an evidence chunk.

## c5_compare
[SYNTHETIC TEST CORPUS; DOCUMENT_KEY=paper_cascade; SECTION_KEY=c5_compare]
Paper Cascade Brief COMPARES_WITH EchoGraph. It states that EchoGraph contributes relation paths while CascadeReader consumes those paths in answer synthesis.
